sections.title: Unit 30: Hungarian Foreign Policy and Energy Policy, 2010–2026
body: This unit follows Hungarian foreign policy and energy policy from 2010 to the spring of 2026 as a finished period. Five accounts cover the Opening to the East, Paks II and Russian gas, the vetoes and the EU funds, Chinese investment, and the debate before the 2026 election.
Each judgement in the texts has a source: the government's reasoning, the critics, an institution. Where a matter was disputed, the other side is named too.
